methods.label: Divide the angle sum into equal parts
methods.explanation:
The three angles of a triangle add to \(180^\circ\). The ratio \(3:3:4\) divides this total into \(3+3+4=10\) equal parts, so each part measures
\[
180^\circ\div 10=18^\circ.
\]
The largest angle corresponds to \(4\) parts, giving \(4\times18^\circ=72^\circ\). The answer is \(\boxed{72^\circ}\), choice \(\text{D}\).
